notes: Update check broken: invalid JSON in latest.json: — the `update-latest-json.sh` script used raw shell variable interpolation (`"$NOTES"`) in a heredoc, which broke JSON when release notes contained double quotes (e.g., `The "Showing" label`). Switched to `jq` which properly escapes all special characters. | Proxy Checker blank screen during load: — added a loading spinner with "Loading proxies..." message that shows while `fetchProxies` is fetching data from the database, so the user sees immediate feedback instead of a blank/empty state. | `update-latest-json.sh`: — now uses `jq` instead of heredoc for JSON generation, ensuring proper escaping of all release notes content.
